name: Tuna & swordfish
description: The open ocean's visiting giants: tunas (Thunnus spp.), Atlantic bonito (Sarda sarda) and swordfish, named 'Tuna & Swordfish' in the source's diet matrix (Table 1 lists the tuna and bonito species). Functional group aggregating the source's single large-tuna compartment; it imports a tiny fraction (0.6%) of its diet from beyond the modelled system, so its diet weights here sum to 0.994.
